notes.title: Version 2.0.0 - Release Notes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Steam Overlay[/b][/h2]

Updated the Steamworks SDK to a newer package, which restores the Steam overlay (Shift+Tab) and related features.


[h2][b]Localization[/b][/h2]

The game is now fully playable in: 

[list]
[*] [b]Czech [/b]
[*] [b]German[/b]
[*] [b]English[/b]
[*] [b]Spanish[/b]
[*] [b]French[/b]
[*] [b]Polish[/b]
[*] [b]Russian[/b]
[*] [b]Ukrainian[/b]
[/list]
[i]* Language can be changed from the Settings menu at any time without losing your hight scores.
[/i]

[h2][b]Controls & Accessibility[/b][/h2]

Reworked [b]keyboard navigation[/b] for smoother, more predictable movement and selection.

Added [b]on-screen hints[/b] so new players instantly see which keys do what.


[h2][b]Roadmap[/b][/h2]

A public Roadmap will be published shortly to outline upcoming features, improvements, and content drops.


[h2][b]Known Issue[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Italian[/b] support is on hold due to unresolved technical issues. It’s on the shortlist and will be added once we sort it out.
[*] [b]SteamDeck[/b] topic still in the air.
[/list]

[i][h3]Thanks for playing and for all your feedback - keep it coming! [/h3][/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes – Controller Support Update
notes.content:
[h3]🎮 Controller Support Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed compatibility issues with PlayStation DualSense controllers on Windows.
[*] Gamepad input now works correctly when launching the game through Steam.
[*] Steam Deck users should now have working controls when Steam Input is disabled.
[/list]

[h3]🛠 Planned Improvements[/h3]

[list]
[*] Preparing further testing and optimizations specifically for Steam Deck to ensure full compatibility.
[*] Future updates may include official Steam Input profiles and controller layout presets.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes – Gamepad Input Fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain gamepad inputs would remain stuck after pressing directional buttons.
[*] Improved gamepad input responsiveness during gameplay.
[/list]
